arxiv-2012-10332.title: 2-Adic Valuations of Quadratic Sequences
arxiv-2012-10332.description: Abstract We determine properties of the 2-adic valuation sequences for general quadratic polynomials with integer coefficients directly from the coefficients. These properties include boundedness or unboundedness, periodicity, and valuations at terminating nodes. We completely describe the periodic sequences in the bounded case. Throughout, we frame results in terms of trees and sequences.

arxiv-2105-05814.title: D5-brane in AdS black holes with nonzero gauge flux
arxiv-2105-05814.creator: Koichi Nagasaki
arxiv-2105-05814.description: Abstract We find the probe D5-brane solution on the black home spacetime which is asymptomatically AdS 5 × S 5 \mathrm{AdS}_{5}\times S^{5} . These black holes have spherical, hyperbolic and toroidal structures. Depending on the gauge flux on the D5-brane, the D5-brane behaves differently.

arxiv-2109-04075.title: Self Supervision to Distillation for Long-Tailed Visual Recognition
arxiv-2109-04075.creator: Tianhao Li, Limin WangGangshan WuState Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University, China
arxiv-2109-04075.description: Abstract Deep learning has achieved remarkable progress for visual recognition on large-scale balanced datasets but still performs poorly on real-world long-tailed data. Previous methods often adopt class re-balanced training strategies to effectively alleviate the imbalance issue, but might be a risk of over-fitting tail classes.

arxiv-2203-01468.title: The quasi time crystal
arxiv-2203-01468.creator: Xintian Wu
arxiv-2203-01468.description: Abstract We discuss the possibility of making a quasi time crystal. A simple two-state model is studied to clarify our definition. In a superposition of the ground state and the excited state and the probability of observation varies periodically in time during the lifetime of the excited state.

arxiv-2305-03418.title: High-Resolution Scanning Tunneling Microscope and its Adaptation for Local Thermopower Measurements in 2D Materials
arxiv-2305-03418.creator: Jose D. Bermúdez-Perez, Edwin Herrera-Vasco, Javier Casas-Salgado, Hector A. Castelblanco, Karen Vega-Bustos, Gabriel Cardenas-Chirivi, Oscar L. Herrera-Sandoval, Hermann Suderow, Paula Giraldo-Gallo, Jose Augusto Galvis
arxiv-2305-03418.description: Abstract We present the design, fabrication and discuss the performance of a new combined high-resolution Scanning Tunneling and Thermopower Microscope (STM/SThEM). We also describe the development of the electronic control, the user interface, the vacuum system, and arrangements to reduce acoustical noise and vibrations.

arxiv-2311-11182.title: Exponentially Convergent Algorithms for Supervised Matrix Factorization
arxiv-2311-11182.creator: Joowon Lee, Hanbaek Lyu, Weixin Yao
arxiv-2311-11182.description: Abstract Supervised matrix factorization (SMF) is a classical machine learning method that simultaneously seeks feature extraction and classification tasks, which are not necessarily a priori aligned objectives. Our goal is to use SMF to learn low-rank latent factors that offer interpretable, data-reconstructive, and class-discriminative features, addressing challenges posed by high-dimensional data.

arxiv-2311-18736.title: Controlgym: Large-Scale Control Environments for Benchmarking Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
arxiv-2311-18736.creator: Xiangyuan Zhang, Weichao Mao, Saviz Mowlavi, Mouhacine Benosman, Tamer Başar
arxiv-2311-18736.description: Abstract We introduce controlgym , a library of thirty-six industrial control settings, and ten infinite-dimensional partial differential equation (PDE)-based control problems. Integrated within the OpenAI Gym/Gymnasium (Gym) framework, controlgym allows direct applications of standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms like stable-baselines3. Our control environments complement those in Gym with continuous, unbounded action and observation spaces, motivated by real-world control applications.

arxiv-2505-07562.title: The JDISC Survey: Linking the physics and chemistry of inner & outer protoplanetary disk zones Facilities: JWST(MIRI)
arxiv-2505-07562.creator: Nicole Arulanantham, Colette Salyk, Klaus Pontoppidan, Andrea Banzatti, Ke Zhang, Karin Öberg, Feng Long, John Carr, Joan Najita, Ilaria Pascucci, María José Colmenares, Chengyan Xie, Jane Huang, Joel Green, Sean M. Andrews, Geoffrey A. Blake, Edwin A. Bergin, Paola Pinilla, Miguel Vioque, Emma Dahl
arxiv-2505-07562.description: Abstract Mid-infrared spectroscopy of protoplanetary disks provides a chemical inventory of gas within a few au, where planets are readily detected around older stars. With the JWST Disk Infrared Spectral Chemistry Survey (JDISCS), we explore demographic trends among 31 disks observed with MIRI (MRS) and with previous ALMA millimeter continuum imaging at high angular resolution (5-10 au).

arxiv-2509-14456.title: Correct-Detect : Balancing Performance and Ambiguity Through the Lens of Coreference Resolution in LLMs
arxiv-2509-14456.creator: Amber Shore, Russell Scheinberg, Ameeta Agrawal, So Young Lee
arxiv-2509-14456.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are intended to reflect human linguistic competencies. But humans have access to a broad and embodied context, which is key in detecting and resolving linguistic ambiguities, even in isolated text spans. A foundational case of semantic ambiguity is found in the task of coreference resolution: how is a pronoun related to an earlier person mention?

arxiv-2605-20755.title: DuplexSLA: A Full-Duplex Spoken Language Model with Synchronized Speech, Language, and Action
arxiv-2605-20755.creator: Haoyang Zhang , Jun Chen , Donghang Wu , Yuxin Li Yuxin Zhang , Xiangyu Tony Zhang , Che Liu , Qingjian Lin Yizhou Peng , Hexin Liu , Eng Siong Chng , Chao Yan Boyong Wu , Yechang Huang , Xuerui Yang , Fei Tian StepFun Peking University Nanyang Technological University Shanghai Jiao Tong University University of New South Wales Imperial College London Equal contribution. Corresponding author.

europmc-pmc7585656.title: Association of Glycemic Indices (Hyperglycemia, Glucose Variability, and Hypoglycemia) with Oxidative Stress and Diabetic Complications.
europmc-pmc7585656.creator: Papachristoforou E, Lambadiari V, Maratou E, Makrilakis K.
europmc-pmc7585656.description: Oxidative stress (OS) is defined as a disturbance in the prooxidant-antioxidant balance of the cell, in favor of the former, which results in the antioxidant capacity of the cell to be overpowered. Excess reactive oxygen species (ROS) production is very harmful to cell...

glengarry-school-days-a-story-of-early-d.creator: Ralph Connor

plos-pone-0350031.description: Longer durations of piperacillin/tazobactam treatment cause more prolonged alteration of colonization resistance in mice

pmc-10518312.title: Non-small cell lung cancers (NSCLCs) oncolysis using coxsackievirus B5 and synergistic DNA-damage response inhibitors
pmc-10518312.creator: Bopei Cui, Lifang Song, Qian Wang, Kelei Li, Qian He, Xing Wu, Fan Gao, Mingchen Liu, Chaoqiang An, Qiushuang Gao, Chaoying Hu, Xiaotian Hao, Fangyu Dong, Jiuyue Zhou, Dong Liu, Ziyang Song, Xujia Yan, Jialu Zhang, Yu Bai, Qunying Mao, Xiaoming Yang, Zhenglun Liang
pmc-10518312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). With the continuous in-depth study of the interaction mechanism between viruses and hosts, the virus has become a promising tool in cancer treatment. In fact, many oncolytic viruses with selectivity and effectiveness have been used in cancer therapy. Human enterovirus is one of the most convenient sources to generate oncolytic viruses, however, the high seroprevalence of some enteroviruses limits its application which urges to exploit more oncolytic enteroviruses.

pmc-10671635.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Characterization of the WRKY Gene Family in Cucurbita maxima
pmc-10671635.creator: Qin Zhou, Ziqing Guo, Xiaojun Zhou, Lei Zhou, Duanhua Wang, Kailiang Bo, Pu Zhu, Zhuo Chen
pmc-10671635.description: In higher plants, WRKY transcription factors are broadly involved in a variety of life activities and play an important role in both biotic and abiotic stress responses. However, little is known about the functions of WRKY genes in the popular species, such as Cucurbita maxima (pumpkin), which is planted worldwide.

pmc-10675558.title: Potential Impacts of Certain N2-Fixing Bacterial Strains and Mineral N Doses for Enhancing the Growth and Productivity of Maize Plants
pmc-10675558.creator: Moustafa Shalaby, Mohssen Elbagory, Nagwa EL-Khateeb, Ahlam Mehesen, Omaima EL-Sheshtawy, Tamer Elsakhawy, Alaa El-Dein Omara, Antonio Juárez-Maldonado, Susana González-Morales, Adalberto Benavides-Mendoza
pmc-10675558.description: The enhancing effect of N2-fixing bacterial strains in the presence of mineral N doses on maize plants in pots and field trials was investigated. The OT-H1 of 10 isolates maintained the total nitrogen, nitrogenase activities, IAA production, and detection of NH3 in their cultures.

pmc-11301995.title: Multilevel medical insurance mitigate health cost inequality due to air pollution: Evidence from China
pmc-11301995.creator: Ennan Wang, Minglai Zhu, Yisha Lin, Xiaoyu Xi
pmc-11301995.description: BackgroundAir pollution affects residents’ health to varying extents according to differences in socioeconomic status. However, there has been a lack of research on whether air pollution contributes to unfair health costs.MethodsIn this research, data from the China Labour Force Dynamics Survey are matched with data on PM2.

pmc-11344776.title: RETRACTED ARTICLE: Mathematical analysis of isothermal study of reverse roll coating using Micropolar fluid
pmc-11344776.creator: Saquib Ul Zaman, Azad Hussain, Kaleem Ashraf, Lubna Sarwar, Faizan Hussain, Ali Altalbe, Ahmet Bekir, Taseer Muhammad
pmc-11344776.description: This article demonstrates a mathematical model and theoretical analysis of the Micropolar fluid in the reverse roll coating process. It is important because micropolar fluids account for the microstructure and microrotation of particles within the fluid. These characteristics are significant for accurately describing the behavior of complex fluids such as polymer solutions, biological fluids, and colloidal suspensions.

pmc-12613879.title: Jasmonates mediate increased levels of ginsenosides in Panax Quinquefolius cambial meristematic cell cultures
pmc-12613879.creator: Pengfei Zhou, Haihua Li, Jiahe Li, Ningjin Liu, Jiarui Wang, Huishan Li, Rulan Zhang, Jingyan Xue, Xiaotian Kang, Chun Yang
pmc-12613879.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCMCs (cambial meristematic cells) are important resources for enhanced biotechnological production of plant secondary metabolites (SMs). However, CMC culture has not yet been established for American ginseng (Panax quinquefolius), an important source of ginsenosides, which are highly active SMs.

pmc-13113545.title: Use of Human Serum Albumin Cys34 (HSA-Cys34) Adductomics as a Multidimensional and Integrative Biomarker Approach to Assess Oxidative Stress
pmc-13113545.creator: Aishwarya Jala, Fariba Tayyari, William E. Funk
pmc-13113545.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Human serum albumin (HSA) is the most abundant protein in plasma, and the redox state of circulating HSA has been used as a biomarker of systemic oxidative stress (OS) for decades. While informative, many traditional biomarkers of OS measure short-lived or downstream products of oxidative damage that offer limited perspectives on the dynamic and integrated processes that govern systemic redox biology within human populations.

pmc-13144848.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2383 LONGITUDINAL DIFFUSION SIGNATURES OF WHITE MATTER MICROSTRUCTURE FOLLOWING CEREBELLAR STROKE
pmc-13144848.creator: Diego Caban-Rivera, Sebastian Urday, Katie Taran, Miguel Montero, Rebecca Clements, Jordan Grafman, Richard Harvey, Molly Bright, Carson Ingo
pmc-13144848.description: Background and aimsMechanisms underlying cerebellar stroke (CS) recovery remain incompletely understood, as conventional MRI may miss subtle microstructural changes in normal-appearing tissue. Advanced diffusion imaging enables longitudinal assessment of white matter integrity beyond infarcted tissue. We aimed to characterize longitudinal diffusion trajectories in lesioned and contralesional cerebellar white matter following CS compared with supratentorial stroke (STS).

pmc-13219182.title: DualKG-DC: A Drug-Centric Dual-Layer Knowledge Graph Framework for Drug Combination Prediction
pmc-13219182.creator: Zhenxiang Gao, Scott W. Perkins, Satya Parameswaran, Rong Xu
pmc-13219182.description: Most existing approaches to drug combination discovery are disease-centered, aiming to identify drug pairs for specific diseases. Complementarily, a drug-centered strategy starts from known drug combinations and explores new therapeutic indications, facilitating translational applications by leveraging combinations with established safety profiles.

pmc-13281877.title: Patient-Reported Outcomes and Wound-Related Quality of Life in Adults with Diabetic Foot Ulcers Treated with Silicone Superabsorbent Polymer Dressings: Exploratory Results from a Prospective Multicenter Nonrandomized Cohort Study
pmc-13281877.creator: David G Armstrong, Jacek Mikosinski, Konrad Panczak, Adam Wegrzynowski, Dorota Piechota, Marek Kotala, Przemyslaw Lipinski, Katarzyna Rybolowicz, Agnieszka Lipinska, Vladica Velickovic, Jacek Bil, Teresa Szenk, Patrycja Buczak, Anitha Pitchika, Sebastian Probst

pmc-13343775.title: Pediatric acute liver failure in a child with arsenic toxicity and underlying rotor syndrome
pmc-13343775.creator: Shivangi Tetarbe, Dhruv Gandhi, Lakshmi Shobhavat, Ira Shah
pmc-13343775.description: Pediatric acute liver failure can result from infections, metabolic disorders, autoimmune diseases, toxins, or malignancies. It is crucial to consider herbal medicines as an etiological factor in such cases. We report a 7-year-old boy presenting with PALF from arsenic toxicity after consuming herbal medicine.

pmc-13502820.title: Clip Combined With Rubber Band vs Clip-Assisted Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography for Difficult Biliary Cannulation in Periampullary Diverticulum: A Propensity Score-Matched Analysis
pmc-13502820.creator: Longping Chen, Jin Zheng, Chuanshen Jiang, Junguo Chen, Zhiping Chen, Zanxuan Qiu, Dazhou Li, Wen Wang
pmc-13502820.description: INTRODUCTION:Successful biliary cannulation is critical to the success of endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP). While various devices and auxiliary techniques have been developed to manage difficult cannulation in patients with periampullary diverticulum (PAD), however, comparative studies on different traction methods remain understudied.

pmc-13640126.title: Sustained seropositivity up to eight years after two-dose inactivated hepatitis A vaccination in Turkish children: a retrospective observational study
pmc-13640126.creator: Özlem Aydemir, Mehmet Köroğu, Aziz Öğütlü, Oğuz Karabay, Aslı Vatan, Sema Çetin
pmc-13640126.description: BackgroundTürkiye introduced a two-dose inactivated hepatitis A vaccination program in 2012 as part of the national childhood immunization schedule. However, data on the long-term persistence of vaccine-induced immunity in Turkish children remain limited. This study aimed to evaluate the durability of anti-HAV IgG responses following routine childhood hepatitis A vaccination.

pmc-13677021.title: Oral Upadacitinib Combined with Phototherapy for Progressive Vitiligo in 7-Year-Old Children: A Two-Case Report
pmc-13677021.creator: Yu Jiang, Zhirong Shu, Shilin Deng, Tingnan Chen, Xiaohong Lin, Jingyao Liang, Yaping Tang
pmc-13677021.description: We report two 7-year-old children with progressive vitiligo despite prior topical therapy and phototherapy; one patient had also received low-dose systemic corticosteroid therapy. Oral upadacitinib, a selective Janus kinase 1 (JAK1) inhibitor, was initiated at 15 mg once daily in both patients in combination with phototherapy.
